findings.evidence: Lines 142–150 already provide the native-cardinality theorem `card_partition_mul_zPart`, and lines 175–177 provide its quotient form; lines 197–205 instead prove only the equality-transported indiscrete specialization.
findings.fix: First prove `Nat.card {σ : Equiv.Perm α // σ.partition = Nat.Partition.indiscrete (Fintype.card α)} = (Fintype.card α - 1)!` from `card_partition_div_zPart`, then derive the transported `parts` and `Fin n` forms as corollaries.
findings.issue: `card_partition_parts_indiscrete` is stated only with an auxiliary `n` and `h : Fintype.card α = n`, although the natural arbitrary-finite-type statement can use `σ.partition = Nat.Partition.indiscrete (Fintype.card α)` directly.

summary: The indiscrete-partition result omits the natural finite-type theorem and exposes an unnecessary cardinality transport equality as its primary interface.
